notes: Pricing is HYBRID. Named models get the explicit rates above; every other model is billed by a parameter-count band with one flat rate for input and output: under 4B $0.10/1M, 4-16B $0.20/1M, over 16B dense $0.90/1M, MoE to 56B $0.50/1M, MoE 56.1-176B $1.20/1M. Those bands have no model id so they cannot be listed here.
The rates above are the Standard serving tier. Priority and Fast tiers cost roughly 1.5x; the exact multiplier varies per model.
Cached-input discounts vary per model (roughly 6-19% of the input rate), not the flat 50% an FAQ page states.
context_window and max_output are not published per model on the pricing page and are omitted rather than guessed.
Dedicated GPU deployments are billed per hour (H100 $7.00, B200 $10.00) and are a different product from this endpoint.
Usage and quota are exposed only through the firectl CLI, not an HTTP endpoint.
